name: cdn-edge-gateway
description: 边缘回源加速网关 — 支持多域名、多源站池、负载均衡、链式回退，可部署于 Cloudflare Workers / Cloudflare Pages / EdgeOne Pages

scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev .
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run build && node scripts/gen-deploy-config.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.deploy.toml && rm -f wrangler.deploy.toml
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy .
scripts.deploy:esa: npm run build && echo '=== ESA 部署步骤 ===' && echo '1) ESA 控制台设置环境变量 REDIS_URL（必填，自建 Webdis/Redis；EdgeKV 收费无免费额度，统一禁用）' && echo '2) npm install esa-cli -g' && echo '3) esa-cli login   (RAM 控制台 AK/SK)' && echo '4) esa-cli commit  (基于已构建的 _worker.js + dist/public)' && echo '5) esa-cli deploy  (选版本/环境)' && echo '详见 docs-site/docs/dev/14-deploy-esa.md'
